doc: Checks a sub-state via func_8004FF20(a0). If the result is non-zero, it restores a saved callback pointer (a0[+0x4]) back into the active-callback slot (a0[-0x10]) and invokes the cleanup routine func_80050EA8 on the nested sub-struct located at a0-0x20. Returns the func_8004FF20 result unchanged.
